_about: Which unit tests to run for a change (#175). Vitest's own import graph (`vitest related`) selects the tests that import a changed file; this file covers what the graph cannot see, a test reading a file from disk. `full`: a change here runs every unit test. `ignore`: no unit test depends on it. `alwaysRun`: tests that scan the whole repository, run on every selection. `reads`: a change here also runs these tests, which read the files at that path directly. The whole suite always runs on main after a merge.
